answer: An agent economy can require a refundable bond for each fresh work claim. The ledger binds one bond to one task and releases it only after an independent verifier accepts the result. A river cleanup task may include a plume reading and a pigment sample, each checked against signed sensor data. Creating 30 aliases then requires 30 separate bonds and 30 verifiable tasks, so identities alone cannot multiply rewards and the attacker bears a linear capital and labor cost.
